prompts.prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Asset type: charcoal drawing texture for a first-person art-studio horror game, portrait 3:4. Create a single authentic observational life-drawing study of a REALISTIC ADULT HUMAN TEACHING SKELETON hanging upright on a narrow metal support stand with small castor base. All bones visible, head to feet, adult 7.5-head proportions, small realistic skull, anatomically proportioned narrow curved ribcage, flared pelvis, long femurs and tibiae, hands resting beside mid thighs. Slight three-quarter turn, arms relaxed almost straight, feet just above wheeled base. Subject occupies central 65% of width and from 12% to 90% of height. No clothing, no flesh. Medium: expressive art-school charcoal and soft graphite on almost white warm ivory paper. Beautiful convincing hand-drawn marks: searching construction lines, selective dark compressed-charcoal contours, lost-and-found edges, energetic cross-hatching, broad side-of-charcoal shading, delicate eraser highlights, paper tooth, a few subtle smudges. Tonal graphite skeleton, NOT a perfect ink diagram, NOT a cartoon, NOT vector art, no circles for joints, no oversized skull. Lots of clean negative paper around figure. Flat front-on scan of the finished paper artwork, no perspective, no surrounding room, no hands, no board, no text, no typography, no captions, no signature, no border, no watermark. Keep pencil strokes legible and grounded, avoid an all-over grey background wash. Lighting is expressed ONLY by shading in the drawing, not by light falling on the page.

Use case: illustration-story. Asset type: portrait 3:4 charcoal drawing game texture. A single beautifully hand-drawn observational study of a realistic adult teaching human skeleton suspended from a thin metal stand with a five-spoke wheeled base. Adult approximately 7.5-head proportions: small realistic skull, narrow natural egg-shaped rib cage, anatomically readable pelvis, long legs, no cartoon joints. Slight three-quarter view. This skeleton leans forward a LITTLE, head tilted, with elbows slightly bent and both arms reaching mildly forward/down toward the viewer, as if suspended in a disturbing pose; fingers articulate naturally. Entire skeleton and wheeled stand fit, feet and skull never cropped. Real art school charcoal drawing on near-white warm ivory paper, expressive confident dark strokes mixed with searching light construction lines, lost and found edges, curved cross hatching around forms, subtle paper grain, rubbed charcoal shadows, eraser highlights. No diagram aesthetic, no smooth vector outlines, no uniform stroke widths, no giant head, no skin or gore. Plenty of empty paper around the figure. Flat scan of just paper artwork, no hands, no desk, no framing, no labels, no text or typography, no signature, no watermark. All shading is charcoal, with no photographic light falling on paper.

Use case: illustration-story. Asset type: portrait 3:4 charcoal drawing texture for an art-studio game. A single elegant, expressive art-school observational still life in charcoal: a classical plaster portrait bust on a short rectangular plinth on the left, two natural pears to its right, all on a table with white linen cloth cascading in broad folds over the front. Unified triangular composition occupies central 70% of page width and middle 70% height with plenty of clean blank paper. Actual adult portrait features, slightly three-quarter view, sculpted neck and shoulders. Hand-drawn fine art quality, imperfect confident gestural lines, light searching construction lines, beautiful dark compressed charcoal accents, variable finger pressure, soft broad side-of-charcoal shading, energetic curved cross-hatching, subtle rubbed smudges, eraser lights, visible tooth of near-white warm ivory paper. No rigid polygonal lines, no cartoon, no vector art, no uniform technical outlines, no border, no text, no signature, no typography, no watermark. Flat front-on scan of ONLY the drawing, not a photograph of a real scene. No drawing hand, pencil or surrounding desk. No all-over grey wash; keep clear light and shadow hierarchy.
